description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 16.12.2019 to 22.12.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and rescinds a previous notification - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory matters. While it names an individual (C. Jayasuriya), this is in an operational capacity to establish legal authority rather than constituting a government personnel appointment with portfolio responsibilities.
